# La Rose Wellness Hub

> La Rose Wellness Hub is a multi-specialty medical centre in New Maadi, Cairo. Clinical nutrition, internal medicine and endoscopy, general and bariatric surgery, dermatology and paediatrics, on a plan built from an actual consultation.

## Specialties

- [Clinical & Therapeutic Nutrition](https://laroseclinics.com/en/specialties/clinical-nutrition.html): A plan based on a proper consultation, not a ready-made diet sheet
- [Weight Management & Non-surgical Alternatives](https://laroseclinics.com/en/specialties/weight-management.html): Weight-loss injections under medical supervision, with weekly follow-up
- [Body Contouring](https://laroseclinics.com/en/specialties/body-contouring.html): Injections for stubborn localised fat, with no surgery and no downtime
- [General Internal Medicine](https://laroseclinics.com/en/specialties/internal-medicine.html): Diabetes, blood pressure, thyroid, and ultrasound in the same visit
- [Liver, Gastroenterology & Endoscopy](https://laroseclinics.com/en/specialties/gastroenterology-hepatology.html): Consultation and ultrasound in the same visit
- [Abdominal Ultrasound](https://laroseclinics.com/en/specialties/ultrasound.html): At your own doctor's request, without a consultation
- [General & Laparoscopic Surgery](https://laroseclinics.com/en/specialties/general-surgery.html): A clear, honest assessment before any surgical decision
- [Bariatric Surgery](https://laroseclinics.com/en/specialties/bariatric-surgery.html): For when surgery genuinely is the right option
- [Dermatology & Aesthetics](https://laroseclinics.com/en/specialties/dermatology.html): Medical treatment for your skin, not generic prescriptions
- [Paediatrics](https://laroseclinics.com/en/specialties/pediatrics.html): Growth and nutrition follow-up from day one

## Doctors

- [Dr. Mohab Ashraf Fouad](https://laroseclinics.com/en/doctors/mohab-ashraf.html): Specialist in Internal Medicine & Diabetes, Hepatology, Gastroenterology & Endoscopy

## Branches

- [Maadi Branch](https://laroseclinics.com/en/branches/maadi.html): Maadi is La Rose’s first branch, bringing all specialties together under one roof. The clinic is in New Maadi, directly behind QNB Bank, with consultations, ultrasound, InBody…
- [Fifth Settlement Branch](https://laroseclinics.com/en/branches/fifth-settlement.html): The Fifth Settlement branch is still being fully prepared, but limited clinics are available to book. The address and remaining opening details will be announced here once…
- [Sheikh Zayed Branch](https://laroseclinics.com/en/branches/sheikh-zayed.html): The Sheikh Zayed branch is currently in preparation and will follow the same integrated consultation model as Maadi. Its address and opening date will be announced here once…
